title: Two-person whiteboarding rehearsal
description: Rehearsal of the first validation environment: two people whiteboarding an idea. Uses real official documentation as supplied sources. NOT the product definition.
objective: By the end of this discussion, decide whether this idea deserves further validation and identify the biggest unknowns.

lines.text: Okay, the idea: an AI presence in meetings that notices when we get stuck on a missing fact and fills it in live.
Like a third person who looks things up while we keep talking.
Can Teams actually give an external product access to live transcript data?
I assume so. We'd need to check.
Why wouldn't Microsoft just build this into Copilot?
Anyway, architecture: a bot joins the call, we get audio, transcribe, detect gaps, research.
The research piece could use official docs first, then the web.
And we only show something if it's actually useful, otherwise it stays quiet.
Do Graph API meeting transcripts become available only after the meeting ends?
If they're post-meeting only, we'd need a real-time media bot instead.
Okay. What should we charge, and what goes into the MVP?
Maybe per seat. The MVP is the side panel and research.
So where does that leave us? Do we validate this?
